variables.name: FABRIC_LAKEHOUSE_PREFIX
variables.note: Read by RuntimeConfig.lakehouse_prefix in src/runtime/context.py, where it is also an environment variable with this exact name. Stage-invariant by design.

variables.name: SilverLakehouse
variables.note: The silver lakehouse pl_master stages from, as @pipeline().libraryVariables.SilverLakehouse. String rather than ItemReference: see this directory's README.

variables.name: GoldWarehouse
variables.note: The warehouse pl_master's stored-procedure activities target. String rather than ItemReference: see this directory's README.

variables.name: LandingRoot
variables.note: OneLake Files/ path that landing_path() resolves against. Stage-invariant by design.

variables.name: Parallelism
variables.note: pl_master's ForEach batchCount. One of the two variables that genuinely differs by stage.

variables.name: Scale
variables.note: nb_00_generate_landing_data's --scale. The empty string is not a scale and nb_00 raises on it, which is how prod refuses to fabricate data. See this directory's README.
